title: Word Association Bridge · Teams
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Word Association Bridge · Teams with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two unrelated everyday words. The lead supplies one word that connects both and explains the connection. The other players can understand both connections. Form two teams. Each team has four turns; only the lead’s teammates respond or assist. Each success earns the team one point. The higher team score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Word Association Bridge, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The other players can understand both connections.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The other players can understand both connections.
